sources.title: Visas to Jordan: Mauritius
sources.officialityEvidence: Jordan Tourism Board identifies this as its official site; its live nationality table expressly names Mauritius.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Mauritius Applicable Visa can be obtained upon arrival, it will cost a total of 40 JOD.

policies.title: Mauritian ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board table expressly states that Mauritian visitors can obtain a paid visa on arrival.
conditions: The official table lists a 40-JOD arrival visa for Mauritius; its visitor guidance also requires Gateway2Jordan QR registration before departure.
Passport validity, purpose, permitted ports, security screening and final admission remain applicable; work, residence and special documents are outside scope.
